title: Modern Techniques in Analysis and Differential Geometry
institution: CIMPA (Centre International de Mathématiques Pures et Appliquées) with Universidad de El Salvador
about: CIMPA research school in San Salvador, 11-23 July 2027, organised with the Universidad de El Salvador, combining analysis and differential geometry, from geometric analysis on surfaces to reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces on compact Lie groups. Applications close 11 March 2027.
requirements: CIMPA schools are aimed mainly at students and teacher-researchers in developing countries
Applications must be made via the CIMPA application site before the deadline on the school's page
